name: macOS
steps: Open Diffy and choose a Git project.
note: Choose File → Install terminal command to use diffy . from your terminal.

name: Windows
steps: Install for your user; administrator access is not required.
Open Diffy and choose a Git project.
note: This alpha has no Windows publisher signature. Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Only install a download you trust.

name: Linux
requirements: x86-64 · Ubuntu 24.04+ · Wayland or X11 · Vulkan driver
steps: Keep the AppImage in a writable folder.
Run the AppImage and choose a Git project.
note: If FUSE is unavailable, run the AppImage with --appimage-extract-and-run. Other distributions are not yet verified.
